notes.title: Announcement on the Suspension of the International Version of Sniper: War of De
notes.notes:
Dear players:

Hello everyone!

Since Reignite launched on Steam, we've been with you through countless joyful days. We sincerely thank you for your continued enthusiasm and support along the way. Due to adjustments to our platform's operational strategy and considering overall operational conditions, it is with deep regret that we announce: the servers will be shut down at 10:00 AM on September 18, 2025, and the game will cease operations. Top-up services will be discontinued on August 13!

From the date of this announcement, we will periodically distribute War Coins or item emails. For Reignite players who enjoy the game and wish to switch to Sniper: The Last Stand (Taiwan server), we will provide compensation!

 

Server Transfer Compensation Rules and Details

1. Historical Top-up Compensation: Based on historical top-up War Coins, 1 War Coin will be awarded 1 Gold Coin in Sniper (Taiwan) (e.g., a 200 War Coin top-up will earn you 200 Gold Coins in Sniper (Taiwan)). Top-up data is current as of August 13th.

2. Players should submit screenshots of their War Server character data to the official administrator for registration (the corresponding Taiwan server account and game name are required, which can be found in the account user center. Compensation can only be claimed once). Please spread the word among War Reignite players!

3. If you have any questions, please contact the group administrator in the group below.
